methodologies.name: PRISMA Scoping Review
methodologies.description: A scoping review following PRISMA Extension guidelines conducted on PubMed to evaluate health risks of social media in children and adolescents under 18 years.
conditions: Search terms: social media, social network, health, pediatrics
Target population: children and adolescents under 18 years old

limitations.text: The existing literature does not allow establishing causality between social media use and internalizing or behavioral problems versus reverse directionality.
The included articles vary significantly in study design (ranging from systematic reviews to clinical studies, letters, and editorials), making accurate comparison difficult.
The literature search was limited exclusively to PubMed and excluded non-English reports.

future_work.text: Development of targeted prevention measures by health practitioners, caregivers, and application developers to protect pediatric populations from social media risks.
Implementation of screening protocols during periodic pediatric check-ups to assess the amount and content of social media exposure.
